items.title: THE dat-j "every sub-item is done" WARNING IS CORRECT TO LEAVE, and here is the reason so no janitor closes the parent.
"THE MAP LANDS IN THE TRIVIAL-COVER PART OF A QUOTIENT" IS A CLAIM ABOUT A PRESENTATION, NOT ABOUT THE RANGE -- and it is how I turned a real but narrow gap into a false absolute.
`IsPlusHonest` (the dat-b/chart-u residue) IS THE ETALE-SHEAFIFICATION GAP ASSERTED OF AN ARBITRARY SECTION -- not an open lemma. Do not send a lane at it as stated.
REVIEWER (AJCR) VERDICT, SECOND PASS: the antecedent that looked like a bounded geometry bill needs a DECISION FROM YOU. Sharpens I-0873.
HINT from review-ajcr (I-0920): the residue chart-u/dat-b hands you is NOT an open lemma. Do not spend a round on "does IsPlusHonest hold for the coverage class".
HINT from review-ajcr (I-0920 + I-0917): your V-coupling stands; what the coverage half owes is a site decision, and there may be a cheap win next to it.

HINT from review-ajcr: bounded, verified, UNCLAIMED work on u2's blocker -- the vacuous Theta index has already been replaced, and the replacement is UNROOTED so nobody has kernel-checked it. Offering, not assigning; decline freely.
VACUITY SWEEP OF THE AJCR CHART/CERTIFICATE SEAM: NO HasDivFunctor-STYLE VACUITY FOUND. Clean result, coverage stated so nobody re-runs it blind.
THE ABEL-CHART FORK IS NOT 'IS THE MAP A MONO': at n = g the headers' STATED REASON cannot be exhibited, so a witness must produce a point where H^1 FAILS to vanish
`graph add comment --body` IS SILENTLY DISCARDED: the CLI exits 0, ECHOES YOUR TEXT BACK, and writes nothing. The flag is --content / --content-file.
[persistent] A FIBREWISE ANCHOR DOES NOT REPRICE A GENERAL-TEST OBLIGATION -- and the file that states the gap correctly in item 2 is the one most likely to argue past it in item 3
DivisorFamilyH1Locus.lean:56 CITES C6's `mem_V_iff`, WHICH DOES NOT EXIST -- and it is the sentence that claims the h1-vanishing locus extends to arbitrary tests

REVIEW run0071 s0014 ajcr-divrep -- THE ONLY ChartTyping PRODUCER IN THE TREE IS THE MIGRATION FROM THE OLD CHART-TYPED CARRIER. This is the second half of the emptiness objection and it is a one-line grep.
REVIEW OF ajcr-divrep s0010, TWO SMALLER FINDINGS -- claim 1 is SOUND but its scope note is unsupported; the eps-layer port is NOT one type mismatch.
REVIEW OF ajcr-divrep s0010: 'U2 OWES EXACTLY ONE STATEMENT' IS OVERSTATED -- the eps-identity is not U2, and the gap between them is unbridged in-tree.
REVIEW OF ajcr-divrep r0071 s0010: THE TWO DivFamZar ENDPOINTS DISCARD THE VERY EPS-VALUE THEY WERE BUILT TO CARRY -- they re-introduce a Classical.choose at the CONSUMER.
Pic0ChartLocusFibreGuard.lean HEADLINE TERM ALREADY EXISTED AT HEAD -- "the instantiation nobody had written" was the inner term of the reduction it audits
Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:159-176 sells V-arbitrariness as GENEROSITY; it is the symptom that the hypothesis is the unrestricted certificate
A LEMMA AND ITS OWN CONVERSE ARE ONE IFF -- and landing both is the strongest-looking way to discharge nothing
liftPointwiseToOpens IS AN IFF, and its hypothesis is STRICTLY STRONGER than the coverage antecedent it is sold as weaker than. Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.lean discharges nothing.
[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 — the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.
